assumptions: Claude Code only; behavior of the host is the documentation as read on 2026-10-24 (changelog to 2.1.310) and is unconfirmed on a host until the probes HV-L1 to HV-L8 are recorded; every delivery transport is unverified and none is selected; agent teams, agent view, channels and monitors are experimental or research previews; one user account on one local macOS or Linux machine with POSIX locking on a local filesystem; the plugin MCP admission lock is per process and is not a cross-session lease; the settings precedence is SPEC-057's decided rule (the most specific scope wins; a block guard mode at repository or user scope is a floor; settings are operator-owned) and the kill-switch floor and every bound marked proposed are assumptions to be confirmed in the G2 review; implementation is blocked by gate G2 (the specs/039 coordination contract, drafted here and not adopted, decided after G1 and opened for planning only after gate GN passes) and a dedicated ADR; the G1 protocol must define a late-notice-harm measure before its freeze, so the Megaphone and the Doorbell stay disabled without a recorded observation under it; EUR 0 additional spend on the founder's existing subscription.
compatibility: Additive and gated. The SPEC-059 push-settings schema extends the SPEC-057 orchestration-settings schema through its versioned extension point and redefines none of its scopes, modes or vocabularies; notices and command errors are the SPEC-057 shapes by reference. No change to agent_braid/analysis.py, AIM 0.2.0-draft, SPEC-023, the SPEC-052 gate and its schemas, the SPEC-057 schemas, the plugin MCP tools, limits or grants, or the existing five product skills. Nothing is planned before G2; if it opens, any notification companion is separate from the guard companion with its own ADR, and the main plugin gains no hook, monitor, channel, mod or MCP tool.
domain: A durable, advisory, content-free coordination ledger for 2 to 32 units per run (up to 8 open runs) on the four documented Claude Code parallel surfaces (workflow-tracks, linked-sessions, agent-teams, batch), on one local macOS or Linux machine and one repository, with opt-in receiver-side push of bounded notices (Megaphone, Doorbell), and a conditional partial hook-observed write ledger for shared-tree agent-teams decided after probe HV-L7; not Codex, cloud or remote sessions, the VS Code extension, Windows, network or synchronized filesystems, other users or machines, or non-Git workspaces.
execution_contract: Local, offline and bounded. The ledger commands invoke no model, network, grant, launch, message, resume, stop or merge; no hook, mod, monitor, channel or MCP tool is added to the main plugin; executionAuthorization is false in every emitted object; results are written only to explicit new private paths or to the private ledger directory; delivery components, if ever built, are opt-in, receiver-side, fail soft and never block a tool call; probes are launched by the orchestrating Claude session after the founder authorizes each individual probe, and the evaluation is run outside this delivery; Agent Braid launches nothing; no concurrent agent, push or remote issue is authorized; no implementation starts before gate G2.
hypotheses: H-LD1 (untested; part (b) of the register entry H-CW2, tested against the pull digest by G1 gate GN, owned by SPEC-057): on real linked-sessions or agent-teams runs a durable ledger with receiver-side digests surfaces a cross-session hazard earlier than the SPEC-057 pull notice, without blocking a tool call or unsafe duplication. H-LD2 (untested): at least one verified transport delivers with loss and duplication low enough, against thresholds fixed before any run, for notices to be useful. H-LD3 (attributed-write export) is withdrawn with the recorder's detailed requirements. Falsification, no-transport-verified, no-collisions-in-G1, a GN that does not pass and a decision not to implement are valid outcomes.
observation_contract: Ledger events as recorded; SPEC-057 declaration digests and receipts; hook inputs as the host provides them to a companion component; session state as printed by the host and supplied by the operator; host behavior only through recorded probe receipts of counts and booleans with the Claude Code version; from a host session listing only a closed field list. Absent, unreadable, unverifiable, busy or over-bound observations are unknown, unverified or not-observed and never clean.

scientific_limits: No acceptance evidence obtained, no host behavior observed and nothing implemented. The ledger is advisory and not a lock; the hash chain is tamper-evident and not authentication; a delivered notice is not a read notice and the host does not acknowledge delivery; hooks cannot see Bash, MCP-tool or generated-file writes; unattributed writers are unknown by default; no PostToolUse Bash observer exists now; plugin hooks firing inside workflow agents, batch units and teammates are inferred (SPEC-057 HV-6), and task-tool presence on the model in use is unconfirmed (SPEC-057 HV-7); the attributed-write export is partial by construction and never yields an independent candidate; idempotency is bounded by a remembered window with no exactly-once claim; POSIX local filesystems only. The cited literature is mostly single-author preprints on research harnesses and none measures Claude Code surfaces. The dogfood datum is an anecdote. The ledger is not claimed as novel, unknown as a result is not claimed as a differentiator by itself, and the only permitted wording is the bounded sentence of ECOSYSTEM.md or no surveyed shipped plugin found with its query set and date. Structural tests prove no semantic or scientific claim. Hypotheses H-LD1 to H-LD3 may be false or inconclusive. No speed claim and no claim that notifications prevent conflicts.
scope: Sketch, for founder review and a later decision, of the Claude Code orchestration ledger and opt-in push: the objective, the limits and the decisions taken (Mailbox + Whisper by default; the opt-in Megaphone and Doorbell gated by a G1 late-notice-harm record, G2, the ADR and, for the Doorbell, a verified transport after G2 and the ADR reframing; a notification companion separate from the SPEC-058 guard companion; the attributed-write ledger decided after probe HV-L7; documentation-only interoperation), the drafted G2 coordination contract (contracts/coordination-contract.md) kept as a draft, and the SPEC-059 extension of the SPEC-057 orchestration settings with its resolved-delivery rule. Implementation is blocked by gate GN, gate G2 and a dedicated ADR; the earlier 17-requirement breakdown was removed by a founder decision of 2026-10-24. SPEC-057 (advisory core, owner of G1) and SPEC-058 (opt-in guard) are separate specifications.
